P.HT: Decision of the Council, meeting in the composition of Heads of State or Government

TI.P: nominating the person it intends to appoint as President of the Commission

PREAMBLE.PREAMBLE.INIT: THE COUNCIL OF THE EUROPEAN UNION,

GR.VISA.VISA: Meeting in the composition of Heads of State or Government,
Having regard to the Treaty establishing the European Community, and in particular Article 214(2), first subparagraph, thereof,

ARTICLE.ALINEA: Mr José Manuel DURÃO BARROSO is hereby nominated as the person the Council intends to appoint as President of the Commission for the period from 1 November 2004 to 31 October 2009.
This Decision shall be forwarded to the European Parliament.
This Decision shall be published in the Official Journal of the European Union.
